newsitem.title: USA: American says plans to refute lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: American says plans to refute lawsuit.

text.p: American Energy Group Ltd said Thursday it has not yet been served with a civil lawsuit by the Securities and Exchange Commission, but it plans to "vigorously" refute the allegations in it.
The company said it has heard of the suit through news services and press accounts.
The company said it has received no contact from the SEC about the alleged filing of civil litigation complaining about inaccurate press releases issued in 1995.
The company said all information it has presented has been accurate and within SEC guidelines.
